WITH recent AS (
  SELECT o.id, o.total, c.name
  FROM orders AS o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.placed_at >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
)
SELECT name, sum(total) AS revenue, rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(total) DESC) AS r
FROM recent
GROUP BY name
HAVING count(*) > 1
ORDER BY revenue DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
